parsed_dict.label: capital_call
parsed_dict.reasoning: This document is clearly titled 'Capital Call Notice' and explicitly states 'ABC FUND, LP pursuant to the terms of the Offering Memorandum, is hereby making a Capital Call' with a due date of March 10, 2020. The document requests the investor (XYZ) to send capital to the fund via wire instructions. This matches the definition of a capital_call notice perfectly - it is a request for an investor to send capital to the fund.
